IS 1200 : Part 9 : 2026 Method of Measurement of Building and Civil Engineering Works - Part 9 Roof Covering (Including Cladding)

ICS 17.029; 91.040.01; 93.010
CED 44

1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 9) covers the method of measurement of roof covering (including cladding) for buildings and civil engineering work.
2 REFERENCE
The standard given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the edition indicated was valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of this standard:
